spec.name: Reversal v22
spec.notes: Fade the last move, rebalanced often.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 2.3, annual return 6%, maximum drawdown 3%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy uses a full sample backtest without any out-of-sample validation. While the Sharpe ratio and drawdown appear reasonable, the lack of robustness testing raises concerns. The research log shows only a limited number of trials and indicates this is not the best performing variant. I recommend paper trading to assess its performance on unseen data before deploying real capital.
